policy: runtime overlay only; it may not change frozen scientific recipes, data, seeds, checkpoint stages or endpoint gates

observed_machine_receipt.policy: receipt is environment evidence only and cannot complete a model or GPU task

resource_rules.gpu_serialization: one training/inference process at a time on the 4090
resource_rules.cpu_parallelism: asset hashing, split validation and deterministic summaries may overlap GPU work
resource_rules.prefetch: model and approved public datasets may be prefetched before recipe freeze
resource_rules.oom: retain and charge attempt; change microbatch/accumulation only through a DEV runtime change record
resource_rules.formal_gate: no FORMAL task before E1_PREFLIGHT_PASS and authorized content evaluator
resource_rules.raw_outputs: restricted_root only; never git or ordinary logs

runtime_only_changes_allowed: gradient accumulation needed to preserve effective batch/order
a800_transfer.required_check: save/reload equivalence plus identical effective batch/order and one DEV loss/metric parity smoke before FORMAL A800 execution
